npcs.name: Gym Leader Brock
dialog: Welcome, challenger!
I am Brock, the Rock-type Gym Leader.
My rock-hard determination has made me who I am today.
If you wish to challenge me, you must first prove your worth!
Navigate through this gym and speak to my trainers.
Only then will I accept your challenge!

npcs.name: Hiker Marcus
dialog: Hah! You think you can just waltz in here?
Rock-type Pokémon are the toughest around!
Their defense is legendary!
Good luck getting past me, kid!

npcs.name: Youngster Joey
dialog: Hey! I'm the newest trainer here!
Brock took me under his wing.
One day I'll be a Gym Leader too!
For now, I guard this side of the gym!

npcs.name: Hiker Boulder
dialog: These rocks aren't just obstacles...
They're ancient stones from Mt. Moon!
Brock collected them himself.
Pretty impressive, right?

npcs.name: Lass Petra
dialog: Don't let the rocks intimidate you!
There's always a path forward.
Just watch your step and think carefully.
The journey is just as important as the destination!
